notes: 353 pieces listed to match the parts list exactly: Racer X car b1-b114, truck cab b115-b255, trailer b256-b353. Minifigure parts and printed sticker applications are not in the parts list, so only the sticker sheet (b114) is recorded as a piece; it is joined to the car's 4x4 plate (b93) as a representative sticker position.

The booklet pictures are small and many sub-assemblies are ambiguous. The assignment of look-alike parts to a specific step, and the rests_on of pieces in sub-assemblies, are best estimates. The type and colour counts are exact.

Earlier fixes kept: grille tiles b233/b234 rest on the studded red hood plate b205 (not on stud-less tiles); the hood sub-assembly, trailer technic plate b311, aquarium block b322 and sticker sheet are all connected to their models; the trailer is coupled to the truck by b334-b148 (final page-48 step).

The two remaining groups are real: the booklet builds the yellow Racer X car (bag 1, pages 4-15) as a completely separate model from the red truck with trailer (bags 2 and 3, pages 16-48). The car never attaches to the truck or trailer in any step, so it is deliberately left as its own connected group. The truck and trailer are one group via the coupling join.

Sub-assemblies built off-model (e.g. b23/b24 car rear section, b130 truck front plate) are joined to the main structure via rests_on or other_joins; loose axles, wheels, tyres and pins (rests_on []) are held only by other_joins.
